hook.text: Some people carry two genetic makeups in one body. Some cells are normal, others carry a mutation.

buildup.text: If a mutation happens after fertilization, only cells from that point carry it. Earlier means more affected cells.

discovery.text: Mosaic Down syndrome means some cells have trisomy 21 and others don't. Symptoms are often milder.

twist.text: Everyone is a mosaic. We all carry mutations in some cells from early development. Most are harmless.

climax.text: Mosaicism blurs the line between healthy and sick. You can carry a disease mutation and never show it.

punchline.text: One body. Two genomes. Mosaicism is everywhere.

quiz.question: What is genetic mosaicism?
options: Having two different genetic makeups in one body's cells
Having extra chromosomes in all cells
